name: Meditation

phases.name: inhale
phases.cue: Breathe in slowly through your nose, sitting tall

phases.name: pause
phases.cue: Pause gently at the top of the breath

phases.name: exhale
phases.cue: Breathe out slowly and let your shoulders soften

phases.name: rest
phases.cue: Rest, and notice the next breath arrive

formTips: Sit cross-legged on the floor or a cushion, knees relaxed out to the sides
Sit tall through your spine with your shoulders relaxed down and back
Rest your hands in your lap, palms up, or on your knees
Close your eyes or let your gaze rest softly on the floor ahead
Breathe slowly through your nose, making the out-breath a little longer than the in-breath
When your mind wanders, notice it and gently bring your attention back to the breath
commonMistakes: Slumping forward and rounding the lower back
Hunching or lifting the shoulders up towards the ears
Forcing the breath instead of letting it slow down naturally
Getting frustrated when the mind wanders
Sitting in a position that makes your legs go numb; use a cushion or a chair instead
